title: Dish
description: A normalized, deduplicated dish in the NYPL 'What's on the Menu?' dataset. A Dish aggregates every transcribed MenuItem that shares the same dish name, with summary statistics about how often and over what period and price range it appeared. Corresponds to a row in Dish.csv.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for the dish. Primary key referenced by MenuItem.dish_id.

name.description: Normalized name of the dish as transcribed (e.g. 'Coffee', 'Consomme printaniere royal').

description.description: Optional longer description of the dish (historically sparsely populated).

menus_appeared.description: Count of distinct menus this dish appeared on.

times_appeared.description: Total number of times the dish appeared across all menus (count of MenuItem rows referencing it).

first_appeared.description: Earliest year this dish was recorded on a menu. A value of 0 indicates unknown.

last_appeared.description: Latest year this dish was recorded on a menu. A value of 0 indicates unknown.

lowest_price.description: Lowest price recorded for this dish across all menus, in the originating menu currency. Decimal with up to 3 places.

highest_price.description: Highest price recorded for this dish across all menus. Decimal with up to 3 places.
